impact.description: Shadow banning / visibility filtering: accounts/posts algorithmically deprioritized without notification, policy violation, or appeal path. Transparency Center provides aggregate reports (removals, government requests) but zero individual visibility into shadow ban status. No 'How to appeal a shadow ban' documentation.

remediation.notes: Aggregate transparency only; no individual recourse
